scientific_question: Does the residual left by the failed v182 global Jacobi-PCGLS1 direction contain deployment-visible camera-by-detector-component heterogeneity that a single observable block Galerkin solve can use while preserving the frozen field, gradient, and observation gates?
role: post-open deterministic mechanism diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p22-s01 frames; it is neither a learned predictor nor fresh generalization
physical_distinction: v183 does not add a second PCGLS iteration, tune v182 beta, or change its Jacobi diagonal. It decomposes the current centered observation residual into co-permuting physical camera-by-detector-component blocks, forms one Jacobi-preconditioned affine-coordinate direction per block, and solves one joint observable Galerkin problem over those block directions.

data_isolation.fit_source: inherit the v178-v182 ten opened PoolFire fit trajectories, affine center and 1009-row basis, and geometry measurement cache without refitting or reselection
data_isolation.heldout_source: exactly p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 already opened through v179-v182
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: the Jacobi diagonal and every block direction
SVD rank, coefficients, candidate, fallback, stopping, and decision
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation generation through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only candidates are sealed

observation_block_primary.name: camera_component_jacobi_block_galerkin
observation_block_primary.centered_system: M a approximately equals r_y, with M=A U^T and r_y=y-A mean_fit
observation_block_primary.row_partition: one block for each active physical camera ID and detector component in {0,1}; within each camera the frozen forward emits the two detector components consecutively for every ray
observation_block_primary.canonical_group_order: ascending physical camera ID, then detector component 0 then 1
observation_block_primary.group_adjoint: g_b=M_b^T r_b for the rows in camera-component block b
observation_block_primary.geometry_preconditioned_direction: z_b=D^(-1) g_b, with D=diag(M^T M) and floor forbidden because the independently validated parent diagonal is strictly positive
observation_block_primary.joint_problem: minimize ||r_y-Q beta||_2 over all block coefficients, Q=[q_1,...,q_B]
observation_block_primary.coefficient_rule: unique minimum-norm SVD solution using only singular values at least 1e-12 times the largest singular value
observation_block_primary.cutoff_separation_rule: if any singular-value ratio lies in [1e-13,1e-11], mark the complete run inconclusive rather than choosing a side of the floor
deployment_inputs: fit-only frozen affine center and basis

blocking_controls.global_observation_adaptive_jacobi_pcgls: inherit the independently validated failed v182 global residual direction without recomputation or reselection
blocking_controls.geometry_rank16_and_jacobi: inherit the independently validated failed v181 controls
blocking_controls.affine_coordinate_cgls1_and_fit_mean: inherit the independently validated failed v181 controls
blocking_controls.full_affine_pseudoinverse: v179 remains the positive high-cost observable capacity reference, not a compact control

evaluation.primary: unchanged physical CGLS K1 from the block-Galerkin warm field must pass both sensor arms
evaluation.cheaper_control: if block-Galerkin K0 also passes both sensor arms, it blocks any claim that the extra physical K1 is needed
evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual; denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened in v176

frozen_operator.forward: the calibrated exact-adjoint straight-ray density-gradient proxy inherited from v176-v182

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.block_algebra: all block adjoints and projected directions are dense algebra on the same sealed M and D cache; no extra physical A/A^T is issued per block
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.truth_observation: one excluded offline forward per sensor arm, calibration, and frame
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.resource_claim: none; the inherited 26260-forward-equivalent cache, dense 1009-coordinate block algebra, and post-open scoring preclude a deployment wall/RSS claim

required_validity_gates: the v182 protocol, formal report, independent validation, decision, selected arrays, recursive parent closure, input trees, and source closure remain unchanged
formal block directions and coefficients use only the current centered observation, reported camera IDs, M, D, center, and affine basis
every expected camera-component group appears once and only once, with no empty or synthesized group
every q_b is finite and nonzero, every SVD is finite, and the fixed cutoff is separated by the preregistered decade buffer
the block-Galerkin K0 centered-observation residual is no larger than the v182 global-line K0 residual within 1e-10
the normal-equation stationarity ||Q^T(Q beta-r)||/(||Q||_2 ||r||_2) is at most 1e-10
the prediction API has no truth parameter and fixed-observation truth mutation leaves coefficients and candidates byte-identical
camera permutation only permutes block columns and changes the reconstructed coordinate and field by at most 1e-10
all exact-call, inherited-cache, block-algebra, and offline-scoring receipts equal the frozen ledger
formal and input trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: the ten fit trajectories, affine center and basis, thirteen calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, all-nine operators, M, D, and current centered observations
camera-component row groups from physical camera IDs and frozen component ordering
every g_b, z_b, q_b, gesvd minimum-norm coefficient, coordinate, K0 field, and observable residual
unchanged physical K1 replay, all 208 metric rows, call receipts, calibration and frame tails, inherited-control blocking, and decision

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, parent, group-partition, operator, direction, SVD, cutoff-separation, stationarity, dominance, observation-only, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v183 inconclusive.
If block-Galerkin K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_OBSERVATION_BLOCK_GALERKIN_V183 and close this camera-component block mechanism.
If K1 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_OBSERVATION_BLOCK_GALERKIN_V183.
If K1 passes five-camera but fails all-nine, conclude FAIL_VARIABLE_CARDINALITY_OBSERVATION_BLOCK_GALERKIN_V183.
If K1 passes both sensor arms and K0 also passes both, conclude PASS_CHEAPER_OBSERVATION_BLOCK_GALERKIN_K0_V183 and prefer the cheaper deterministic control.
Only if K1 passes both sensor arms, K0 does not pass both, and all inherited cheaper controls remain failed may v183 conclude PASS_OBSERVATION_BLOCK_GALERKIN_K1_HEADROOM_V183.

No v183 outcome is a learned algorithm, external generalization result, deployable exact-call reduction result, wall/RSS result, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
